summary: The candidate fixes native cache-ID alignment and adds valid API/identity/shared-cache plumbing, but operational caller-ID caching remains limited to Kimi K3 images. Video, audio, general image processors, and Responses previous_response_id no-I/O reuse remain unresolved or unverified.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-d46c8b85e16a/venv/bin/python (base GenerateReqInput video_data plus mm_cache_ids reproduction)
tests.what_was_measured: The recorded base does not implement the proposed native API and raises TypeError for mm_cache_ids; the exception was captured as expected by the reproduction script.
Exact candidate focused regressions: 94 passed and 27 subtests passed, including native video alignment, protocol retention, and a synthetic shared artifact-cache hot hit.
Compatibility only: 170 passed and 70 subtests passed. These tests do not prove real multimodal previous_response_id no-I/O reuse.
Independent call-site inventory: only Kimi K3 forwards request mm_cache_ids into prepare_media_artifacts; its processor supports images only.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X was visible through Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015, but no compatible multimodal weights were available. The tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify this multimodal contract.

remaining_counterexamples: A repeated Chat video_url with the same cache_id cannot obtain the promised no-I/O hit because no video processor passes cache_ids to prepare_media_artifacts.
A repeated Chat audio_url with the same cache_id cannot obtain the promised no-I/O hit because no audio processor passes cache_ids to prepare_media_artifacts.
Responses previous_response_id has no real multimodal serving evidence that historical media skips read/download, decode, preprocessing, and feature hashing.
Caller-ID artifact caching is operational only for the Kimi K3 image processor, not images generally across supported processors.
remaining_limitations: Compatible multimodal model weights were unavailable, so real HTTP/GPU multimodal serving was not run.
No native source changed; a native rebuild was not applicable.
The candidate's passing shared-cache unit test proves the cache primitive, not that video/audio/general processor call paths reach it.
